description: Trigger accuracy evaluation for the kling-ai skill. Each entry is a user prompt that should or should not trigger this skill. Used with the skill-creator eval framework.

should_trigger.query: Make me a Kling AI prompt for an image-to-video animation of a perfume bottle with subtle light reflections.
should_trigger.why: Direct Kling I2V request - canonical trigger

should_trigger.query: How do I make an AI video where someone is talking? I have a photo of the person and a recorded voiceover.
should_trigger.why: Avatar 2.0 use case - photo + audio = talking avatar

should_trigger.query: What's the difference between Kling 3.0 and Kling 2.6?
should_trigger.why: Model selection question - core skill scope, should also point to Kling 4.0.

should_trigger.query: Help me write a cinematic prompt for a 4-shot storyboard about a product launch.
should_trigger.why: Multi-shot storyboard - Kling 3.0 feature

should_trigger.query: Animate this image so the hair moves gently in the wind.
should_trigger.why: Image-to-video motion prompt - canonical trigger

should_trigger.query: I want to use the same character across multiple Kling videos. How?
should_trigger.why: Character consistency - Element Reference, documented in skill.

should_trigger.query: How much does Kling cost per video? Is the free tier enough for testing?
should_trigger.why: Pricing question - skill covers this (in references/pricing.md)

should_trigger.query: My Kling generation is stuck at 99%. What went wrong?
should_trigger.why: Troubleshooting - covered in Common Issues table

should_trigger.query: Translate this Polish prompt into something I can paste into Kling.
should_trigger.why: English-prompt policy is core skill content

should_trigger.query: How do I use Draft Mode in Kling to save credits?
should_trigger.why: "Draft Mode" is a term invented by third-party reviews. Trigger on the Kling mention; the skill should steer to real options (720p, Flash), not confirm the feature.

should_trigger.query: Stwórz mi prompt do Klinga na video produktowe perfum.
should_trigger.why: Polish-language Kling request - skill handles cross-language

should_trigger.query: I need to generate a 30-second talking head video in Polish from a single photo.
should_trigger.why: Avatar 2.0 + duration constraint - skill should explain Avatar workflow

should_trigger.query: I need 20 short clips of a presenter talking for a course - which Kling model keeps the cost down?
should_trigger.why: VIDEO 3.0 Turbo is the cheapest 1080p with sound; Kling 4.0 Flash is cheaper at 720p. Skill should compare both.

should_trigger.query: Can I swap the product in an existing video for a different one without regenerating the whole shot?
should_trigger.why: VIDEO 3.0 Omni video editing - documented object-swap capability with 3-15s input and 4K support.

should_trigger.query: How much does a 10 second 4K Kling clip cost through the API?
should_trigger.why: API rate card - 4K is a flat 3.0 U/s on VIDEO 3.0 and Omni. Kling 4.0 has no 4K price, skill should say so.

should_trigger.query: My edited Kling video keeps drifting from the original camera angle.
should_trigger.why: Missing explicit unchanged list in the editing prompt - documented in Common Issues.

should_trigger.query: Should I use Kling 4.0 or Kling 4.0 Flash for a 15 second product clip?
should_trigger.why: 4.0 vs Flash - core 2026-11 model choice: 720p only, no last frame or keyframes on Flash.

should_trigger.query: I have 5 images of key moments and want a video that hits each one at a set time.
should_trigger.why: Multi-keyframes on Kling 4.0, up to 10 images.

should_trigger.query: Write a Kling Omni Reference prompt: this photo is the character, this clip is the dance.
should_trigger.why: Omni Reference - asset roles are the critical rule.

should_trigger.query: Why can't I get 4K from kling-video-v4_0?
should_trigger.why: Status table: 4K is not enabled in the CLI and coming soon in the API. Use VIDEO 3.0 or Omni.

should_trigger.query: Kling keeps adding subtitles and music to my clip.
should_trigger.why: Official 4.0 guidance: write no subtitles and no background music.

should_trigger.query: Can Kling 4.0 lip-sync to my ElevenLabs recording?
should_trigger.why: Audio input on 4.0 is voice reference only. Avatar 2.0 is the correct path.

should_trigger.query: How much does Kling 4.0 cost through the API if I give it a reference video?
should_trigger.why: Flagship Units and billed-duration rule: output x 2 or input + output.

should_trigger.query: My Kling edit generated a whole new video instead of changing the original.
should_trigger.why: Prompt said Reference. Must say Edit @Video1.

should_trigger.query: Generate a 25 second single take in Kling.
should_trigger.why: Only Kling 4.0 goes past 15s in a generation (up to 30s).

should_not_trigger.query: Generate a thumbnail for my YouTube video about cooking.
should_not_trigger.why: Image generation, not video - nano-banana skill territory

should_not_trigger.query: Write me a Veo 3 prompt for a product commercial.
should_not_trigger.why: Different video model (Google Veo), not Kling

should_not_trigger.query: How do I install Premiere Pro on macOS?
should_not_trigger.why: Video editing software install, not AI video generation

should_not_trigger.query: Recommend a stock footage site for my landing page.
Help me write a YouTube video description for my latest upload.
should_not_trigger.why: Text content for video - not Kling prompt

should_not_trigger.query: What's the best codec for exporting a 4K video from Final Cut?
should_not_trigger.why: Video export technical question, no AI generation involved

should_not_trigger.query: Suggest a tagline for a marketing video about insurance.

edge_cases.query: I'm comparing AI video tools - is Runway Gen-4 or Kling 4.0 better for my use case?
edge_cases.why: User mentions Kling explicitly and asks for comparison - skill should engage on the Kling side

edge_cases.query: I have a SaaS product, write me a 30-second ad video script.
edge_cases.why: Video script, not AI video generation prompt. No Kling/Avatar/I2V terms.
